newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Guangdong ITIC to sign US$35 mln loan.
newsitem.headline: Guangdong ITIC to sign US$35 mln loan.

text.p: Guangdong International Trust and Investment Corp HK Holding Ltd's US$35 million term loan facility will be signed on Friday, arranger CCIC Finance said.
The facility has a tenor of five years.
Proceeds are to be used to finance the acquisition by GITIC HK of a 50 percent interest in HCD Toll Road Co Ltd and for working capital requirements.
HCD Toll Road Co owns the right to operate and receive tolls from 82 km of completed toll roads in Huadu City, Guandong City
Paricipating banks are Shinhan Finance, CCIC Finance, Bank of China New York, First Merchant Banking Corp, Nippon Credit Bank Hong Kong, IBJ Leasing Hong Kong and Industrial Bank of Korea Hong Kong.
